name: Tanya
source:
Tanya was the protagonist's girlfriend during college. She grew up in a very religious household, and had never been with a guy before, but turned out to have quite the sexual appetite once she got a taste. Tanya is also the one to name the protagonist's penis "Zeus" (it is big, strong, and shoots lightning, according to her).

She finished college a few months before the protagonist and went home, they didn't want to do a long distance relationship so they broke up. The protagonist later found some sexy photos of her in an envelope in his bag that she had left as a goodbye present.

[spoiler]However, it turned out that the protagonist [i]did[/i] leave her with a parting gift of sorts, and a few months into the story, Tanya unexpectedly show up at the protagonist's home, revealing herself to be six months pregnant! After the initial shock (he fainted) the protagonist unhesitatingly accepts her back and embrace becoming a father. (Allison also welcomes her with open arms.)

When her parents found out she was pregnant out of wedlock they gave her the choice of staying with her aunt in Florida for a few months, have the baby and give her up for adoption, or leave permanently. She chose the latter and so is completely at loss what to do now. The protagonist then quickly remodels the unused basement into an apartment for her.[/spoiler]

[i]At one point, the protagonist calls her eyes "violet" but that is not exactly a natural colour for eyes, and the renders clearly show her to have light blue eyes so I went with "blue" for the traits. (He can't have been referring to her eyeshadow either as it is more turquoise than violet.)[/i]
